32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Clean grid layout and deliberate Paul Tol palette, but 5 of 9 cells render completely empty in the screenshot due to staggered init timing, leaving the gallery looking half-built.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Bar and area transitions maintain zero baselines correctly, d3.pack uses area-correct circle sizing, but y-scale domains are hardcoded to [0,1] and data joins lack key functions — acceptable for a synthetic morphing demo.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: No user-driven events (no brush/zoom/click), so Update Storm, Infinite Loop, Stale Scale, and Mouse-Touch criteria are N/A; minor risk from missing .interrupt() before loopMorph transitions and unhandled promise rejections from .end().then(cb) if transitions are interrupted.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9 cells with staggered-start animation loops is manageable as a browse-not-analyze gallery, but simultaneous looping across all cells once initialized fragments attention with no focal point; 6 of 9 cells appear blank at screenshot capture time, revealing a visible initialization gap on load.
